name: task-workflow
description: Task-size work, from idea to merge: describe a task (with mockups a team member approves), plan it against the knowledge graph, create its Jira, GitLab or GitHub ticket and move its draft folder to the key, bring a playground task up to the full quality bar, and archive the tasks whose ticket is done (description status kept in step with the tracker, every hub link moved with the folder). Several drafts can wait for a ticket at once.
